_source: docs/reference/design-principles.md, 'Checks before you ship' -> Plain words; issue #3107 (Sam, 2026-11-11). Starter list as written there; tests/cdc_plain_words.test.js reads avoid_words.
avoid_kinds: any acronym that isn't spelled out
role names the users don't hold

avoid_words.why: an insider name for the nightly database count; say 'database count'
say what the figure is: the account totals for AI time
a field name from the builder, never a word on the page
an issue number means nothing to a reader; say what it is
a time is shown in Pacific time, in words
a date is written in words (Nov 17, 2026)
say 'since' with the date in words
a file path is folded under 'For the team', never in the line a reader sees first
a model's name is an insider word
say which count it is (also a term kb/plain_words.py lists)
the page's date says what it is beside the header's Last Updated
